name: scroll
summary: Scrolling tiled background system: linked list of ScrollLayer entries loaded from .tex WAD files. Render with parallax using camera-written gScreenScrollX/Y. Also renders sprite frames for HUD/menu via sprite_draw.
functions: scroll_add — Create ScrollLayer from .tex WAD entry, prepend to sScrollList. Params: path, flags, scroll speeds (16.16), render list ID.
scroll_remove — Remove and free a ScrollLayer from sScrollList.
scroll_tile_render — Render one layer's texture strip to screen via gDPLoadTextureTile + gSPTextureRectangle. Handles wrapping for repeating backgrounds (two branches: narrow vs wide texture).
scroll_render — Main frame render: iterate sScrollList, compute screen Y position from scroll offsets, clip, call scroll_tile_render per visible layer. Fill fog color below lowest layer.
scroll_debug_iter — Empty stub iterating SpriteDef entries. Does nothing (dead code?).
sprite_draw — Render a single animated sprite frame from Object's SpriteDef. Used for HUD/countdown elements. NON_MATCHING.

structs.ScrollLayer: Texture layer: width, height, hasPalette, flags, imageData, palette, xOffs, yOffs, speedX (16.16), speedY (16.16), next pointer.

globals.gScreenScrollY: s32 — Vertical screen offset. Defined here, written by camera.c each frame.
globals.gScreenScrollX: s32 — Horizontal screen offset. Defined here, written by camera.c each frame.
